ValidationRule.description: Retired: Salesforce record currencies are independent and cross-currency Opportunities can be valid.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISBLANK(AccountId)), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(AccountId), ISCHANGED(CurrencyIsoCode)), TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) != TEXT(Account.CurrencyIsoCode))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Opportunity Currency must match the Account Currency. Choose the Account currency before adding products.
